requirements.statement: Anonymous onboarding supports role selection and natural-language input
Anonymous preview uses an isolated ephemeral principal and system tenant
Anonymous preview cannot access durable memory, workspace, BYOK, external tools, or enterprise data
Claim saga imports exactly once and records deletion receipts
Email/password registration, verification, login, logout, reset, change email and password
Session listing, selective revocation, rotation, CSRF and anti-enumeration
Account export, erasure request and cancellation
Personal and enterprise tenants resolve from trusted session and membership context
Invitation, membership lifecycle, CSV bulk management and tenant isolation
Onboarding confirms inferred capabilities as claims backed by evidence
Route exposes transfer bridge, gaps, stages and first task with immutable revisions
Today selects exactly one causal task for the focused active Mission
Task, submission and review support code, writing and design practice
Claim correction creates new claim and route revisions and makes old results stale
Multiple Missions maintain exactly one focus when executable Missions exist
Coach is grounded, preference-aware and cannot cross action boundaries
Create covers Project, required Milestones, Workspace, tests, Evidence, Artifact revisions, reflection and portfolio export
Settings cover locale, timezone, reminders, BYOK, Memory, export and erasure
EventStore, projection, outbox and idempotency response commit atomically
Run, ToolCall, Command, Attempt and Approval use explicit state machines
Worker results match version, command, attempt, fence, lease token and expiry
At-least-once delivery is deduplicated by inbox and stable effect keys
Unknown side effects reconcile or require approved repair without blind retry
Realtime reconnects from tenant-user last_seen_seq and is not a fact source
Provider Gateway records every attempt and prevents SSRF, rebinding, redirect and secret-host mismatch
Five immutable Agent Profiles record context manifests and pass independent bilingual gates
Workspace publish follows prepared, durable authorization, CAS publish and confirmation
Artifacts are content-addressed, encrypted, scanned, ACL-protected and revisioned
Memory writes only occur through governed memory_write ToolCalls
Retrieval is tenant-scoped, source-labelled and reconstructable
Programs, Cohorts, role packs and task packs support enterprise learning
Private content is unavailable to admins and reviewers without explicit share grants
Aggregate analytics use allowlists, stable suppression, k>=5 complements and query budgets
Product cannot be used for employment-rights decisions or member ranking
Offline contracts define seats, entitlements and credit buckets through audited admin proposals
Usage reserve, settle, release and adjustment ledgers reconcile without negative balances or duplicates
BYOK excludes provider fees while recording platform resources
Sensitive operations require password reauthentication no older than five minutes
Repair and contract activation require two distinct valid approvers excluding initiator
Deletion spans payloads, memory, indexes, workspace, artifacts, caches and restored backups
Compose, Helm/OpenTofu and cloud cells support install, upgrade, backup, restore and rollback
Telemetry, audit, SLOs, sweeper, repair, load, DR and release gates are production defaults
AGPL/commercial licensing includes notices, CLA, trademark, security, SBOM and signed provenance
